answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the haven log shows the live set and the grove audit records each lapse. Keeping 124 aliases alive hence means 124 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the jade quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 807 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 3 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
